entities.summary: Soledad Estorach Esterri was a Catalan anarcha-feminist. She created the Institut Mujeres Libres and Casal de la Dona Treballadora. She contributed to the papers Tierra y Libertad and Mujeres Libres as well as a book which was collectively written, Mujeres Libres.
